boxes.title: Structural comparison: finite von-Neumann ordinals and the unary provenance chain
boxes.summary_markdown: The finite von-Neumann successor chain and the externally adjoined b=1 address grammar are isomorphic as rooted directed graphs under n -> 0^n, where 0^n denotes the word of n zero-slots. This is a structural comparison only; CNNA retains b>=2 and does not identify ordinal sets with provenance nodes.
boxes.uncertainty_or_limit: The graph-isomorphism statement is elementary and exact. Its scientific role is contextual: it does not contribute a premise to the derived-only DAG.
not_claimed: No identification of natural numbers or ordinals with CNNA nodes.
No derivation of arithmetic or set membership from the provenance grammar.
No extension of the active CNNA input domain from b>=2 to b=1.
No claim that depth identifies a node once b>1.

boxes.title: Empty carrier, singleton representation, and a payload-free seed
boxes.summary_markdown: C001 and A001 match standard initial/terminal-object patterns in Set; the singleton implementation value represents uniqueness rather than content.
boxes.uncertainty_or_limit: The universal-object comparison is exact in Set but contextual; all CNNA state transitions remain separately defined.
not_claimed: No claim that category theory causes root genesis.
No identification of the executable singleton value with a provenance node.
No extra scientific degree of freedom is inferred from the representation.

boxes.title: Shortlex order turns provenance words into a canonical base-$b$ schedule
boxes.summary_markdown: The C018 schedule is shortlex order and admits a closed length-tagged base-b index formula.
boxes.uncertainty_or_limit: The index formula is elementary and exact for the fixed C018 convention; it does not add a new node identifier to the core state.
not_claimed: No claim that ordinary integer arithmetic identifies provenance nodes.
No removal of leading zeros from addresses.
No claim that shortlex is forced by the grammar rather than chosen by C018.

boxes.title: Conductance normalization as a positive scaling orbit
boxes.summary_markdown: C*=1 chooses a representative of a positive conductance-scaling orbit; normalized response is the orbit invariant.
boxes.uncertainty_or_limit: The rational scaling theorem is proved internally; the network literature supplies only established context for conductance homogeneity.
not_claimed: No physical gauge-field identification.
No local or node-dependent rescaling symmetry.
No claim that all future observables are scale invariant.

boxes.title: One block operation, four disciplinary names
boxes.summary_markdown: Schur complement, Gaussian elimination, DtN response, and Kron reduction are disciplinary views of the same block elimination.
boxes.uncertainty_or_limit: The common algebraic core is exact; application-specific assumptions remain distinct and are tracked separately.
not_claimed: No identification of all physical application domains.
No claim that the cited undirected theorem establishes CNNA directed closure.
No claim that CNNA invented the block formula.

boxes.title: Exact elimination before floating-point linear algebra
boxes.summary_markdown: C006 sits in the exact-elimination tradition but does not implement the Bareiss algorithm.
boxes.uncertainty_or_limit: The historical comparison is methodological; C006 correctness rests entirely on its own exact-value proofs.
not_claimed: No algorithmic equivalence to Bareiss elimination.
No claim of optimal arithmetic complexity.
No prohibition on floating-point diagnostics outside the exact core.

boxes.title: The directed Laplacian is minus a Markov generator
boxes.summary_markdown: Q=-K has continuous-time Markov-generator sign structure, but CNNA does not postulate stochastic dynamics.
boxes.uncertainty_or_limit: The sign duality is exact under the C007 row/source convention; any stochastic interpretation would require additional normalized state semantics.
not_claimed: No probability law.
No identification of birth time with Markov time.
No claim that conductances are normalized transition probabilities.

boxes.title: Established ingredients, nonstandard derivation chain
boxes.summary_markdown: The local mathematics is largely standard; CNNA novelty is the provenance-locked composition and exclusion of unowned inputs.
boxes.uncertainty_or_limit: This positioning is an interpretive boundary, not a theorem. The global novelty claim remains contingent on completeness and coherence of the full derived chain.
not_claimed: No claim of novelty for rooted trees, words, graph Laplacians, Schur complements, or Kron reduction.
No claim that citation of standard ingredients proves the CNNA global chain.
No claim that the kernel-verified local P001 closure by itself proves the complete CNNA chain.

boxes.title: Formalization boundary: reusable directed closure kernel-verified
boxes.summary_markdown: The Core remains mathlib-free. The separate proof package kernel-verifies exact semantics, the directed maximum principle, finite solve well-posedness, response well-definedness, directed-Laplacian structure, strict distinguished-port positivity, canonical-cut instantiation, and independent cut-family reuse.
boxes.uncertainty_or_limit: The current P001 evidence is exact-source-bound to 142 declarations. The separate M003/M004 end-to-end closure modules are source-complete and require their own local Lean build and axiom-audit gate.
not_claimed: No Matrix.PosDef or Hermitian surrogate is used.
No determinant, inverse, pseudoinverse, regularizer, symmetrization, or grounding vertex is introduced.
No claim is made that the new M003/M004 closure modules are kernel-verified before the local build gate passes.

boxes.title: Proof nodes are reusable closure gates
boxes.summary_markdown: A proof node represents one independently falsifiable and reusable closure gate; helper lemmas remain internal.
boxes.uncertainty_or_limit: The decomposition may be refined only when a genuinely independent reusable theorem is identified.
not_claimed: No claim that proof-node count measures mathematical depth.
No claim that a planned P-node has executable Python or elaborated Lean code.
No permission to move CNNA definitions into mathlib-dependent modules.

boxes.title: Open full-robust formalization objective
boxes.summary_markdown: A future fully constructive stack would eliminate even transitive propext, Classical.choice, and Quot.sound dependencies from proof theorems.
boxes.uncertainty_or_limit: This would require rebuilding substantial rational, quotient, extensionality, and algebra infrastructure. It is a legitimate research goal but disproportionate at the present P001 node and is not a freeze gate.
not_claimed: No assertion that the current proof has an empty #print axioms profile.
No acceptance of project-local hidden axioms or sorry.
No requirement to reimplement Lean/mathlib before proving the CNNA-specific theorem.
